name: IHRISCompetencyEvaluation
title: iHRIS Competency Evaluation
description: The `competency_evaluation` list as shipped by default in iHRIS 4.3.3 (modules: ihris-common/module/person-simple-competency). Codes are the iHRIS record ids. Deployments add their own records, so this is the shipped baseline, not a closed international code set.
